witness.construction: For each n in 2..200, the n collinear points x_j = (j, 0), j = 0,...,n-1, form the arithmetic progression {0,1,...,n-1}. From the endpoint x_0 the squared distances to the other points are 1^2, 2^2, ..., (n-1)^2, i.e. exactly n-1 distinct values.

claim: An exception-free run (exit 0) certifies the finite core of L1: for every n in 2..200 the collinear AP {0,...,n-1} is a set of n DISTINCT points in R^2 and the endpoint vertex has exactly the n-1 distinct squared distances {1^2,...,(n-1)^2}, verified in exact integer arithmetic, fail-closed, deterministic, no imports or I/O. covers="fragment": this certifies the construction core of L1 over n=2..200; the general bijection proof for all n>=2 and the g(n) asymptotic bound are separate pieces.
law: Wang 7.2: an exact finite object plus a proved reduction is a CERTIFICATE. The reduction is the `claim` and is a human's to audit; the object and the verifier run are the machine's part.
